title: CoinGecko Crypto Scraper
description: Scrape cryptocurrency market data from CoinGecko by coin ID, search query, or top coins by market cap. No API key required (optional Demo key for higher limits).

searchQueries.title: Search Queries
searchQueries.description: Coin names/symbols to look up and resolve to coin IDs (e.g. "bitcoin", "doge").

topCoins.title: Top Coins by Market Cap
topCoins.description: Number of top coins (by market cap) to scrape. Set to 0 to scrape only the specified coins/searches.

apiKey.title: CoinGecko API Key (optional)
apiKey.description: A CoinGecko Demo API key raises rate limits. Leave empty to use the free public API.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Rotating proxies help avoid the free API's rate limits on large runs.
